mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserStat */ USER_STAT FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getUserTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , CONCAT('닉네임: ', U.USER_NICK) AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getBackgroundTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , F.FILE_NUMB , CONCAT('배경사진: ', COALESCE(F.ORIG_NAME, F.STOR_NAME, '파일명 없음')) AS TAGT_CNTN , F.ORIG_NAME , F.STOR_NAME , F.FILE_PATH , F.MIME_TYPE FROM TM_USERXM U JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.BGIM_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getReportTargetDtl */ R.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , COALESCE(R.REPT_CNTN, '') AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_REPORT R JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} WHERE R.REPT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND R.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND R.PUBC_YSNO = #{commYes} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getReplyTargetDtl */ C.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , COALESCE(C.REPL_CNTN, '') AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TB_REPLXX C LEFT JOIN TM_REPORT R ON C.TAGT_TYPE = 'REPORT' AND R.REPT_NUMB = C.TAGT_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM O ON (C.TAGT_TYPE = 'PROFILE_IMAGE' AND O.PROF_NUMB = C.TAGT_NUMB) OR (C.TAGT_TYPE = 'BACKGROUND_IMAGE' AND O.BGIM_NUMB = C.TAGT_NUMB) JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} WHERE C.REPL_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND C.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND COALESCE(C.DELT_YSNO, #{commNo}) = #{commNo} AND ((C.TAGT_TYPE = 'REPORT' AND R.PUBC_YSNO = #{commYes}) OR O.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = COALESCE(R.USER_NUMB, O.USER_NUMB)) OR (B.USER_NUMB = COALESCE(R.USER_NUMB, O.USER_NUMB) AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getProfileTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , F.FILE_NUMB , CONCAT('프로필 사진: ', COALESCE(F.ORIG_NAME, F.STOR_NAME, '파일명 없음')) AS TAGT_CNTN , F.ORIG_NAME , F.STOR_NAME , F.FILE_PATH , F.MIME_TYPE FROM TM_USERXM U JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getIntroTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , U.INTR_CNTN AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} AND NULLIF(TRIM(U.INTR_CNTN), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptAutoProfile */ TM_USERXM SET PROF_NUMB = NULL WHERE USER_NUMB = #{tagtUser} AND PROF_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending})

UPDATE /* uptAutoBackground */ TM_USERXM SET BGIM_NUMB = NULL WHERE USER_NUMB = #{tagtUser} AND BGIM_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending})

UPDATE /* uptAutoIntro */ TM_USERXM SET INTR_CNTN = NULL WHERE USER_NUMB = #{tagtUser} AND NULLIF(TRIM(INTR_CNTN), '') IS NOT NULL AND USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending})
mapper.select: SELECT /* getAutoResultEventDtl */ C.TAGT_TYPE , C.TAGT_NUMB , C.TAGT_HASH , MAX(C.TAGT_USER) AS TAGT_USER , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{complaintTargetCode}, C.TAGT_TYPE, NULL) AS TAGT_NAME , COUNT(DISTINCT C.CMPL_RSON) AS RSON_CNTT , MIN(C.CMPL_RSON) AS RSON_CODE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{complaintReasonCode}, MIN(C.CMPL_RSON), NULL) AS RSON_NAME , MAX(C.PROC_DATE) AS PROC_DATE FROM TH_CMPLNT C WHERE C.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND C.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND C.TAGT_HASH = #{tagtHash} AND C.CMPL_STAT = #{complaintStatusActioned} GROUP BY C.TAGT_TYPE, C.TAGT_NUMB, C.TAGT_HASH
mapper.insert: INSERT /* setTargetResult */ INTO TH_CMRSLT (EVNT_NUMB, CMPL_NUMB, USER_NUMB, RCVR_TYPE, REGI_DATE) SELECT #{eventNumb}, #{cmplNumb}, U.USER_NUMB, #{receiverTarget}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatSuspended})
mapper.select: SELECT /* getPendingResultList */ R.RSLT_NUMB , R.RCVR_TYPE , CASE WHEN R.RCVR_TYPE = #{receiverReporter} THEN C.CMPL_NUMB END AS CMPL_NUMB , E.TAGT_NAME , CASE WHEN R.RCVR_TYPE = #{receiverReporter} THEN FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{complaintReasonCode}, C.CMPL_RSON, NULL) ELSE E.RSON_NAME END AS RSON_NAME , CASE WHEN R.RCVR_TYPE = #{receiverReporter} THEN E.RPTR_CNTN ELSE E.TGTR_CNTN END AS RSLT_CNTN , CASE WHEN R.RCVR_TYPE = #{receiverReporter} THEN C.REGI_DATE END AS CMPL_DATE , E.PROC_DATE FROM TH_CMRSLT R JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB JOIN TH_CMREVT E ON E.EVNT_NUMB = R.EVNT_NUMB JOIN TH_CMPLNT C ON C.CMPL_NUMB = R.CMPL_NUMB WHERE R.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND R.CONF_DATE IS NULL AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} ORDER BY R.RSLT_NUMB LIMIT #{maxSize}
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delExpiredEvidence */ FROM TH_CMEVDC WHERE EVDC_NUMB IN ( SELECT X.EVDC_NUMB FROM ( SELECT E.EVDC_NUMB FROM TH_CMEVDC E WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TH_CMPLNT C WHERE C.EVDC_NUMB = E.EVDC_NUMB AND C.CMPL_STAT IN (#{complaintStatusReceived}, #{complaintStatusReviewing}) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TH_CMPLNT C WHERE C.EVDC_NUMB = E.EVDC_NUMB AND C.PROC_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY C.EVDC_NUMB HAVING MAX(C.PROC_DATE) < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY) ) ORDER BY E.EVDC_NUMB LIMIT #{batchSize} ) X )
